maddeler.e:
أنطبق (form VII)
# أَنْطَبِقُ (ʔanṭabiqu) /ʔan.tˤa.bi.qu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْطَبَقَ (inṭabaqa)
# أَنْطَبِقَ (ʔanṭabiqa) /ʔan.tˤa.bi.qa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْطَبَقَ (inṭabaqa)
# أَنْطَبِقْ (ʔanṭabiq) /ʔan.tˤa.biq/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْطَبَقَ (inṭabaqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
